:::{#thm-loghaz-decomp}
#### Decomposition of log-hazard
$$
\ba
\loghaz(t|\vx) = \loghaz_0(t) + \diffloghaz(t|\vx)
\ea
$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: proof

$$
\ba
\loghaz(t|\vx)
&= \logf{\haz(t|\vx)} && \text{(definition of log-hazard)} \\
&= \logf{\haz_0(t)\hazfactor(t|\vx)} && \text{(proportional hazards hazard decomposition)} \\
&= \logf{\haz_0(t)} + \logf{\hazfactor(t|\vx)} && \text{(logarithm of product rule)} \\
&= \loghaz_0(t) + \diffloghaz(t|\vx) && \text{(definitions of baseline log-hazard and log-hazard difference)}
\ea
$$

:::
